hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Mean tail Linf displacement on HAPT validation split is 0.1345; max tail displacement reaches 16.09 (ramp counterexample).

hypotheses.title: Same activity label does not guarantee identical CNN predictions

hypotheses.empirical_evidence: 78 prediction flips observed across 2,661 adjacent pure-label pairs; witness global row 682->683 flips class 10->8.

hypotheses.title: Local invariance region existence from strict winner and continuity
premises: Continuous graph operators in real field
strict top-1 margin > 0

positive margins inf_{x in D}(f_c*(x) - f_j(x)) > 0 for all j!=c*
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Conjunction of formal gate, store verification, and validated bound engine achieves 100% reference agreement in runtime executor.

hypotheses.title: Sound Lipschitz upper bound provides certified ball radius

hypotheses.title: Interval Bound Propagation is incomplete (wrapping / cancellation loss)
premises: Rectangular coordinate interval propagation ignores inter-neuron dependencies
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Analytical toy model h1=h2=ReLU(t+1) incurs cancellation gap = 2.0; paired validation ablation in W4-017 confirms 149.47 margin hull loss.

hypotheses.title: Direct margin vector objectives reduce dependency cancellation loss
premises: Evaluating W_c - W_j in single affine transformation before intervalization
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Direct margin method LB(f_c - f_j) >= LB(f_c) - UB(f_j) verified analytically and numerically on 100% of tested pairs.

hypotheses.title: CROWN relaxation tighter than IBP but has higher computational cost
premises: Linear relaxation of non-linear activations with backward bound propagation
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: auto-LiRPA produces tighter bounds than pure IBP at the expense of ~5-10x latency per query evaluation.

hypotheses.title: Temporal PCA subspace captures empirical sensor motion correlations
premises: Low-rank manifold hypothesis on 6-channel human locomotion trajectories
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: PCA with K=8 explains 98.4% variance of tail increments; orthonormal basis yields ~57 margin units tighter bounds than random basis control.

hypotheses.title: Structured domain superiority requires matched-volume and matched-budget comparison
premises: Fair comparison between unstructured isotropic balls and structured wave domains
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Volume of fixed-overlap wave is degenerate (0 volume in R^768 due to fixed prefix); direct radius comparison is invalid without dimensionality matching.

hypotheses.title: Fixed prefix reduces free perturbation dimensions from 768 to 384

hypotheses.empirical_evidence: CandidateBox free_dimensions confirmed 384 for h=1 (wave) vs 768 for h=2 and isotropic full boxes.

cumulative pooling stride 4 divides 64
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Conv3 feature map positions j=2..13 at step t+1 match j=18..29 at step t bit-for-bit (3,866,112 scalars verified with max abs diff = 0.0).

hypotheses.title: Global Average Pooling delta update is not applicable to Flatten-MLP classifier head
premises: SmallCNN1D reference uses Flatten(2048) -> Linear(128) -> ReLU -> Linear(12)
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Weights of Linear1 are position-dependent; shifting feature columns across spatial positions breaks linear combination.

hypotheses.title: Re-centering certificates after reuse without re-execution causes cumulative drift
premises: Floating anchor updates on accepted queries allow unbounded drift
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Adversarial drift witness demonstrates cumulative error escaping safe region; fixed-anchor invariant with deterministic max_age eliminates drift 100%.

hypotheses.title: Fixed anchor certificates preserve multi-step soundness up to deterministic expiration
premises: Immutable certificate store
fixed anchor coordinates
hard expiration at anchor_step + max_age
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Replay validation confirms 100.0% decision agreement with reference model across all evaluated stream queries.

hypotheses.title: Finite horizon multi-step reachable sets have decaying tightness
premises: Shift-append recurrence over stride-64 streaming windows
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Free dimensions double from 384 at h=1 to 768 at h=2; outer product-set box relaxation evaluated on 50 validation triplets.

hypotheses.title: Exact box membership checking has worst-case Theta(m) complexity
premises: Coordinatewise interval comparison over m=768 dimensions
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Measured membership latency ~0.014 ms in pure NumPy elementwise comparison; SIMD vectorization achieves sub-microsecond throughput.

hypotheses.title: Mathematical soundness does not guarantee empirical useful coverage
premises: Sound conservative enclosures often have near-zero membership probability under natural sensor dynamics
hypotheses.proof_source: Week 3 benchmark results (zero next-window hits for eps=1e-6)
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Radius 1e-4 achieves 100% mathematical soundness but 0.0% streaming reuse; radius 0.5 achieves 78% reachability.

hypotheses.title: High verification and identity checking costs can eliminate caching speedup
premises: Zero-trust cryptographic assertion on every query incurs significant computational overhead
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Full SHA-256 assert_identity takes 1.394 ms (76.8% of M01 infer time, 5.98x slower than bare PyTorch M00); owned reference M16 recovers 4.13x speedup.

hypotheses.title: Owned reference architecture resolves identity overhead while preserving security
premises: Process-internal memory encapsulation by ReferenceOwner
HMAC session salt rotation
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: M16 achieves 0.439 ms infer latency (1.45x of M00) while detecting 100% of injected mutations at boundaries.

hypotheses.title: Real-field verification theorems do not automatically transfer to IEEE-754 float32
premises: Rounding errors, catastrophic cancellation, subnormals, and non-associativity in float32 arithmetic
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Audited outward rounding primitives and NumericalCapability gate formally prevent unsound float32 decisions.

hypotheses.title: Event name / activity status cannot serve as certification authority
premises: Human activity annotation is an external descriptive label, not a neural network mathematical invariant
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Query with identical activity label but outside certified domain is rejected fail-closed; admission is governed strictly by geometry.

hypotheses.title: Simultaneous attainment of formal soundness, useful reuse, and net speedup
premises: Trilemma between formal proof soundness, empirical physical reachability, and computational verification overhead
hypotheses.empirical_evidence: Characterized exact Pareto frontier: M16 with incremental Conv3 feature reuse provides net acceleration under strict gate.
